name: Duroply Industries Limited
about: Duroply Industries Limited manufactures and sells plywood and allied products in India. It provides plywood and blockboards, flush doors, and decorative veneers under the DURO brand name. The company was formerly known as Sarda Plywood Industries Limited and changed its name to Duroply Industries Limited in December 2018. Duroply Industries Limited was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
